method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: Act ss 4(1), 9(1)(a)-(e), (2), 11(1), (6), 11AB(1), (2), 12, 13(1), (2A), (3), (4), 14(1), 20A, 20B(1), (5), (6), 20E, 21(1)-(3), 22(1), (3), (5)-(7), 23A, 25, 26, 27, 27AA, 28, 29(1)-(4), (6), (9), (10), 30(1), (2), 32(1), 35(1), (2), 37, 40(3), 43, 44(2), (3), 45(1), 46, 47, 53, 54, 56(1), 57(1)-(3), 58(2), (3), 59(2), (2A), 68(2), 75D(2); Regulations regs 10, 24, 26(3) items 1 and 2(a), 38 (rate as input) -- the insured's pre-contract duty (reasonable care for consumer contracts and for a life insured in super; disclosure otherwise), the insurer's s 22 notices, misrepresentation and relevant failure, the insurer's remedies for general and life insurance (including the 3-year limits and group life cover), misstated age, the utmost good faith both ways and its civil penalty, terms the insurer may not rely on, s 54, claims-made notice, fraudulent claims, interest, renewal and cancellation notice, standard sickness and accident cover. Out: ASIC and administration, insurable interest, Key Facts Sheets, flood, interim and instalment contracts, third party beneficiaries' claims, subrogation, cancellation grounds, s 27A, ss 31 and 56(2) relief, ss 69, 71, 75, other standard covers, protected genetic information
seat: the insured (and, for cover inside a super fund, the life insured)
